findings.message: Timer start/stop/pause behavior is undefined — can the timer be paused? What happens if a lap is created while timer is stopped?
Session persistence is not specified — are sessions saved automatically, on exit, or manually? Where are they stored?
What happens when creating a lap at elapsed time 0:00? Is a zero-duration lap valid?
Maximum limits undefined — is there a maximum number of laps, sections, or takes per session?
'Section' vs 'lap' terminology is inconsistent — the spec mentions 'section name' labels on laps, but the hierarchy says Sections contain Takes. Are laps and takes the same thing?
Target talk duration mentioned in UI but never defined — how is it set, edited, or cleared?
Practice mode entry/exit conditions unclear — how does the user start practice mode? Can they exit without resetting?
Template queue behavior when empty is unspecified — what happens if user creates more laps than template entries during practice?
Undo/redo scope unclear — does undo work across practice mode transitions? Is the stack cleared on reset?
Duration adjustment constraints missing — can durations be set to zero? Negative? What's the maximum?
Import format not specified — what file format is imported? How are parsing errors handled?
Markdown export format not defined — what structure does the exported Markdown follow?
Tag naming constraints undefined — are there character limits, forbidden characters, or case sensitivity rules for tags?
Multiple sessions handling unclear — can users have multiple talks open? How do they switch between them?
Keyboard shortcuts are mentioned but not enumerated — which keys perform which actions?
'Translucent overlay mode' behavior undefined — how is it toggled? Does it affect interactivity?
Show/hide mechanism for rehearsal not specified — is this a system tray, hotkey, or window behavior?
No offline/online behavior specified — does the app require network connectivity?
No browser/platform requirements specified — is this web, desktop, or mobile?
Accessibility beyond keyboard shortcuts not addressed — screen reader support, color contrast, focus management?

summary: Core timer mechanics and session lifecycle need clarification; terminology inconsistency between laps/takes/sections; practice mode flows and persistence behavior are underspecified.
